# @thewaver/ss-components-svelte

> Svelte components for building shaped UI. Headless: structure, behavior and ARIA wiring only —
> no color, spacing or typography. The consumer supplies all visual styling.

Peer dependencies: `@thewaver/ss-utils`, `svelte`. Depends on `@thewaver/ss-components`, the framework-free core,
whose exports it re-exports. CSS entry point: `@thewaver/ss-components/styles.css`
(structural only, required). Full prop tables and interactive examples: https://ss-components.vercel.app

The examples on the site are written for Solid. The Svelte components carry the same names and props, with plain
values where Solid takes getters and `bind:` where Solid takes a signal; a `render*` callback in Solid is a snippet
of the same name in Svelte.

Browser only: drawing these components on a server is not tested.

Authoritative signatures, prop types and prop-level doc comments are in `dist/index.d.ts` inside the
published package — read that for ground truth on any single component rather than this file.

## Components

Grouped by the source tree's own top-level folders.

### Essentials — the standard control and layout set
Accordion, AudioSwitcher, Breadcrumbs, Button, Calendar, Carousel, Checkbox, CheckboxGroup, Clock,
Collapsible, ColorArea, ColorInput, CommandPalette, CurrencyInput, DateInput, DatePicker, DateRangePicker,
DateTimePicker, Drawer, EdgeFader, FileInput, FlyoutMenu, Form, FormField, FormSection, HoverCard,
ImageSwitcher, Label, Listbox, Menu, Menubar, Modal, MultiListbox, MultiSelect, NumberInput, Paginator,
Preview, Progress, Radio, RadioGroup, Range, RangeCalendar, Scroller, SegmentedInput, Select, SharedTooltip,
Sidebar, SlideButton, Sortable, SplitPane, SpotlightGuide, SpotlightHint, SpotlightPrompt, Stepper, Table,
TableOfContents, Tabs, TagInput, TextArea, TextInput, TimeInput, TimePicker, Toasts, Toggle, Toolbar, Tooltip,
Tree.

### Exotics — visual and motion effects
Bracket, CardStack, CellAnimation, CirclePacking, CornerHighlight, CornerPin, Cuboid, Die, DrumWheel,
ElementMosaic, FanMenu, FittedText, FlipCard, Flipbook, Formation, Icicle, ImageMosaic, InfiniteCorridor,
Lens, LightCatcher, MorphText, OverheadWheel, PaintedText, ParticleDissolve, ParticleField, ParticleSpawner,
PatchBoard, ProximityText, RGBAnimation, Reveal, RichText, Satellite, ScanlineAnimation, ScrambleText,
ScratchCard, ShadowCaster, Shape, SlotText, SortableGrid, Staircase, Sunburst, TileBoard, Tilter, Timeline,
Trail, Treemap, Typewriter, ViewportWrapper, WheelMenu, Wraparound.

### Composites — assemblies of the above
GlassSurface, Surface.

### Primitives — lower-level building blocks the above are built from
Barrel, BinarySwitch, FormValue, InteractionSettings, InteractionWrapper, Mosaic, PlacementBox, PlacementItem,
Popover, PopupTrigger, Spine, Spotlight, TextField, Wheel.

### Abstracts — Svelte helpers for state and behavior (no markup of their own)
Anchor, Carrier, ColorExtractor, DateTimeValue, Dismisser, ElementFader, ElementObserver, Elevation, Floater,
FocusManager, FrameRateMonitor, Glass, HoverIntent, InteractionTracker, LetterDriver, MaskedField,
MediaQueryMonitor, Navigator, PanZoom, PointerTracker, Roller, Rotator, Selection, Shortcut, SignalMirror,
SliceRenderer, Smoother, TextSync, Typeahead, Viewport, Virtualizer.

### Samples
Sample and registry data for the Exotics above (keyframes, weights, gradients, patterns, layouts, connectors), meant
to be copied or referenced, not a stable API surface.
